exposure: Paper narratives and matrix header/count-integrality QC seen; new gene-level estimates not inspected. Four named donors x four concurrent 24-hour conditions, 32734 genes, integer raw counts.
unit: four named primary human lung fibroblast donors; four conditions matched within donor
design: Concurrent TGF-beta x CHIR factorial; no verified initial subtype or prestimulation state. CHIR is downstream GSK3 inhibition, not receptor-selective agonism.
normalization: TMM effective library size from complete supplied count matrix, then log2(CPM+1). Library-total CPM+1 normalization as fixed sensitivity. No numerical comparison with mouse atlas levels.
coverage_rule: Flag gene counts >=10 in >=4 libraries as adequately detected for descriptive interpretation; retain and label all requested mapped genes even when below this floor. Panels remain fixed; report adequately detected membership.
primary_context_estimand: Within-donor interaction: (combined minus TGF) minus (CHIR minus vehicle). Estimated directly, not by comparing significance labels.
summaries: Every donor contrast; mean, median, observed range, sign counts and leave-one-donor mean range. No P values, significance categories, population-confidence claim or genome-wide discovery.
panels_rule: Equal-weight mean log2(CPM+1); no receptor genes in panels. No favorable-gene removal or refill.
sensitivity: All four leave-one-donor means under fixed normalization; total-count normalization direction; no outcome-based donor exclusions.
biological_limits: RNA cohort (4 Munich donors) differs from organoid cohort (8 Groningen donors), so no donor-level RNA/function mediation join.
RNA at 24h versus functional fibroblast pretreatment at 48h; no matched maturation timeline.
No direct Fzd1 versus Fzd2 contrast, ligand secretion, deposited matrix or mature epithelial output in count file.
No independent replicated Jones Notch contrast found after GEO and BioSample review.
Hyperoxia neonatal function supplies a stage-specific comparator; no equivalent adult AF1/AF2 state assumed.
